labels.text: section 151(d)(1): the statutory 'exemption amount', before the 1990-forward inflation adjustment of section 151(d)(4) and the 2018-2025 zeroing of section 151(d)(5)

section 151(d)(1): 'the term "exemption amount" means $2,000', unindexed statutory base. `s151-152-exemptions-dependents.law` reads this value only for taxable years before 1990-01-01 (before the (d)(4) inflation adjustment starts) and does not conclude `base_exemption_amount_151` for 1990-01-01 through 2017-12-31 or for years after 2025-12-31: the published (Rev. Proc.) inflation-adjusted dollar amount for any such year is NOT pinned by this task (SOURCE_GAP), consistent with the standard-deduction and additional-standard-deduction sidecars in this same package. Recording the raw $2,000 figure here (rather than inventing an indexed value) is deliberate; a consumer must not read this value directly for a post-1989 year without applying the missing COLA.
